Now DESPITE this, this product, the so-called "holy grail", caused a monstrous bout of fungal acne - the itching and non-stop irritation was UNREAL. It wreaked havoc on my skin for MONTHS and I couldn't figure out what was wrong because I would've NEVER guessed that this "calming" product was the culprit. I actually even went extra dose on it, thinking it would "calm" my skin down. Nope! New cystic acne every other day, in addition to the flareup of fungal acne!! Mind you, I've had clear skin for over a decade now. And guess what? The cystic acne flareups stopped the DAY i stopped using centella. Now I'm just treating my fungal acne and deep scarring from cystic acne, and I have no idea how long that will take because I've never in my life had fungal acne. My skin texture is completely damaged. This product and this company needs to be sued because unlike the glowing fake reviews here, Reddit is TALKING. Be WARY, BUYERS!!!
